title: DTZ listeleri ve filtreler
summary: Kelime, kalıp ve cümleler konuya ve sınav bölümüne göre düzenlendi.
before: Ham kelime ve ifade adayları hatalar ve eksik parçalar içeriyordu.
after: Gözden geçirilmiş kelimeler ve tam ifadeler ile özgün örnek cümleler konuya ayrıldı; kelimeler türüne göre filtrelenebilir.

steps.title: Kelime türleri ve konular
steps.check: İsim, fiil, sıfat ve zarfı; sınav bölümü ve konu seçimlerini dene.

steps.title: Kalıplar ve cümleler
steps.check: Konu ve sınav bölümü filtrelerini kontrol et; cümleler ayrı bir bölümde.

title: DTZ kelime, kalıp ve cümleler
summary: Obsidian analizindeki kelime biçimleri, tüm kalıp adayları ve 260 özgün örnek cümle.
before: Sınav bölümünde yalnızca DTZ denemesi vardı.
after: Temel işlev sözcükleri dışında tüm kelime biçimleri, 3.627 otomatik kalıp adayı ve 260 örnek cümle listelenir; kaynak sınırları belirtilir.

steps.title: Sınav bölümü
steps.check: Üç yeni bağlantıyı masaüstü ve telefonda kontrol et.

steps.title: Çalışma sayfası
steps.check: Listelerin kapsamını, 100 öğelik grupları ve kaynak sınırlamalarını kontrol et.

title: Compact DTZ toolbar
summary: The reading and speaking toolbar becomes compact when pinned during scrolling.
before: The sticky toolbar occupied extra vertical space.
after: When pinned, only the timer or suggested duration and save/pause control remain.

steps.title: Reading toolbar
steps.check: Scroll down: only countdown and Kaydet ve ara ver remain. Scroll up to restore the full bar.

steps.title: Speaking toolbar
steps.check: Scroll down and check the compact suggested duration and save control on desktop and phone.

title: Simpler review comments
summary: Comment buttons now target main components. Saved reviews can be edited or deleted.
before: Plus buttons appeared on many small elements; saved feedback could not be changed.
after: Main components have plus buttons. Each saved review has Edit and Delete; Approved and Save note remain.

steps.title: Main components
steps.check: Plus buttons appear on main areas. Open a dialog to review its main components.

steps.title: Edit and delete
steps.check: Save a note, edit its text, then delete it. Existing reviews are preserved until you change them.

title: Remove free resources section
summary: The free resources section and downloads are removed from the local website output.
before: The site generated a resources page and published two study files.
after: The page and downloads return 404; topic and DTZ pages remain.

steps.title: Homepage
steps.check: Resource banner and unfinished B1 letter link are removed.

steps.title: Café topic
steps.check: The topic remains available without a download link.

title: Review comments and component feedback
summary: Applied the three saved comments. Every visible website component has a local review comment button.
before: Phone navigation stayed expanded; the header included Free resources; the DTZ introduction had an extra final sentence. Feedback targeted whole walkthrough stops.
after: Phone navigation opens with Menu. The Free resources header link and final DTZ introduction sentence are removed. Plus buttons attach feedback to a named component and page; original notes are preserved for your review.

steps.title: Phone menu
steps.check: Choose Phone: open Menu, follow a link and close with Escape. Free resources is absent from the navigation; downloads remain available in the homepage.

steps.title: DTZ introduction
steps.check: The final sentence about opening the page without downloading audio has been removed.

steps.title: Component comments
steps.check: Click a plus beside a heading, link, section or control. The editor names that component. Save a note, or clear the target to review the whole stop. Toggle component buttons off to walk through unobstructed.

steps.title: Dialogs and live content
steps.check: On desktop open the language dialog; comment buttons also work inside it. Navigate freely to topic and legal pages.

title: Faster homepage, same design
summary: Responsive café images, smaller Turkish/German fonts and content-versioned asset caching. Changes are local; new live PageSpeed scores have not been measured.
before: The 215 KB café image was sent to all screens. The two main Lato fonts totaled 425 KB. Mutable asset URLs required browser revalidation.
after: Phones can request a 38 KB or 76 KB hero variant. The two Lato-derived faces (renamed Baulingo Sans) total 92 KB. Built image/font URLs include content hashes and receive immutable caching; normal HTML still revalidates.

steps.title: Phone image
steps.check: Choose Phone and check the same café photo, crop and phrase panel. The smaller responsive image should remain clear.

steps.title: Desktop homepage
steps.check: Choose Desktop and check headline, spacing and photo quality. Artwork and typefaces are unchanged.

steps.title: Turkish / German text
steps.check: Check accents, umlauts, Turkish letters and punctuation. Font subsets retain their original glyph outlines and metrics.

steps.title: DTZ writing
steps.check: Inspect task lettering and type Turkish/German text into the sample draft. This is still an isolated review attempt.

steps.title: Resources
steps.check: Check the resource banner and open the free notes. Asset caching changes should not change their appearance or access.

title: Exam navigation and homepage cleanup
summary: Sınavlar now comes before Ücretsiz kaynaklar. The unfinished A1 family reunification link was removed from the homepage.
before: The top menu had no exam entry. The exam column included the unfinished A1 family reunification link.
after: Konular → Günlük Almanca → Sınavlar → Ücretsiz kaynaklar. Sınavlar opens the DTZ simulation. The A1 link is gone.

steps.title: Top navigation
steps.check: Check the menu order and open Sınavlar. At 320 px the menu uses two rows.

steps.title: Exam links
steps.check: The unfinished A1 link should be absent. The free DTZ link should open the full simulation.

steps.title: Exam destination
steps.check: Sınavlar is the active navigation entry. Confirm the same menu order on this page.

steps.title: Free resources
steps.check: The DTZ entry and both existing free study notes remain accessible.

title: Full DTZ simulation on the website
summary: The original app simulation now has a web player with listening, reading, writing, speaking and receptive results.
before: The website offered short topic explanations and a sentence activity. The full DTZ simulation was available only in the app repository.
after: A free web simulation with the original audio, 45 scored questions, writing/speaking prompts, local resume and answer review. Writing and speaking are not automatically graded.

steps.title: Landing page
steps.check: Check the introduction, timings, free access and practice-only disclaimer. Opening this page should not download the audio.

steps.title: Listening
steps.check: Start the real audio and try the answer controls. Use Next stop to inspect reading without waiting for the full recording.

steps.title: Reading
steps.check: Inspect the texts, examples, radio choices and 45-minute timer. This is an isolated sample attempt.

steps.title: Writing
steps.check: Switch between tasks A/B and edit the sample draft. This preview never touches your normal saved attempt.

steps.title: Speaking
steps.check: Switch candidates A/B. Check both pictures and the three speaking tasks. No microphone recording or automatic grade is offered.

steps.title: Results and answers
steps.check: Inspect an example result and expand the answers/model letters. This is sample progress, not a real learner result.
